change: Active foreground duplicates validate their source on a bounded background worker. Each incoming duplicate replaces pending validation evidence; unchanged source keeps its generation, changed/unreadable source enqueues one replacement during UI polling. Navigation cancels old validation; completion of the original decode does not lose a required reload. Reload preserves image index, scalar window and development recipe and re-enters foreground prefetch priority.
limitations: Blocked reader is controlled with synchronized channels, not a physical slow disk.
The source identity retains the existing sampled fingerprint semantics.
An OS read can still block its worker; checks retain no mosaic or thumbnail pixels.
Native ordinary-navigation observations do not exercise source modification during an active duplicate request.
Dropped-path metadata inspection still performs UI-thread filesystem access.
